summary.content:
Today's selection covers 103 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How Google Is Starting to Win the A.I. Race
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Verizon DBIR: Enterprises Face a Dangerous Vulnerability Glut
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 77 articles published in the last 24 hours
